<img width="1200" height="320" alt="banner" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5c73b505-dc5b-42d3-a238-8fc6ae603c9c" />
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 320" width="1200" height="320" role="img" aria-label="Project banner" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#151935"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#232a5c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ink" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#7FE7C4"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#8EA2FF"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#F7A8D8"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="gradientTransform" type="translate" values="-0.6 0; 0.6 0; -0.6 0" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8EA2FF" stop-opacity="0.35"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8EA2FF" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <clipPath id="card"><rect width="1200" height="320" rx="18"/></clipPath>
  </defs>

  <style>
    .title {
      font: 800 84px "Segoe UI", -apple-system, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      fill: url(#ink);
      fill-opacity: 0;
      stroke: #E8ECFF;
      stroke-width: 1.4;
      stroke-dasharray: 900;
      stroke-dashoffset: 900;
      animation: draw 2.4s ease-out forwards, fill 1s ease-in 1.9s forwards;
    }
    .tag {
      font: 400 24px "Segoe UI", -apple-system, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
      fill: #C9D0F5;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: rise 0.9s ease-out 2.6s forwards;
    }
    .orbit { fill: none; stroke: #8EA2FF; stroke-opacity: 0.18; stroke-width: 1.2; }
    .spin1 { transform-origin: 960px 160px; animation: spin 14s linear infinite; }
    .spin2 { transform-origin: 960px 160px; animation: spin 22s linear infinite reverse; }
    .spin3 { transform-origin: 960px 160px; animation: spin 34s linear infinite; }
    .star { fill: #E8ECFF; animation: twinkle 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .cursor { fill: #7FE7C4; opacity: 0; animation: rise 0.1s linear 2.6s forwards, blink 1s steps(1) 2.7s infinite; }

    @keyframes draw { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
    @keyframes fill { to { fill-opacity: 1; stroke-opacity: 0; } }
    @keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes twinkle { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.2; } 50% { opacity: 0.9; } }
    @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation: none !important; }
      .title { fill-opacity: 1; stroke-opacity: 0; stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
      .tag, .cursor { opacity: 1; }
    }
  </style>

  <g clip-path="url(#card)">
    <rect width="1200" height="320" fill="url(#bg)"/>

    <!-- stars -->
    <circle class="star" cx="120" cy="40"  r="1.4" style="animation-delay:.2s"/>
    <circle class="star" cx="300" cy="280" r="1.1" style="animation-delay:1.1s"/>
    <circle class="star" cx="520" cy="30"  r="1.6" style="animation-delay:.7s"/>
    <circle class="star" cx="660" cy="290" r="1.2" style="animation-delay:2s"/>
    <circle class="star" cx="760" cy="60"  r="1.3" style="animation-delay:1.5s"/>
    <circle class="star" cx="1150" cy="40" r="1.5" style="animation-delay:.4s"/>
    <circle class="star" cx="1120" cy="285" r="1.2" style="animation-delay:2.4s"/>
    <circle class="star" cx="40"  cy="250" r="1.3" style="animation-delay:1.8s"/>

    <!-- orbital system -->
    <circle cx="960" cy="160" r="150" fill="url(#glow)"/>
    <circle class="orbit" cx="960" cy="160" r="60"/>
    <circle class="orbit" cx="960" cy="160" r="100" stroke-dasharray="4 8"/>
    <circle class="orbit" cx="960" cy="160" r="140"/>
    <circle cx="960" cy="160" r="16" fill="#8EA2FF"/>
    <circle cx="960" cy="160" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#8EA2FF" stroke-opacity="0.5">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="16;34" dur="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="stroke-opacity" values="0.5;0" dur="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <g class="spin1"><circle cx="1020" cy="160" r="6" fill="#7FE7C4"/></g>
    <g class="spin2"><circle cx="960" cy="60" r="8" fill="#F7A8D8"/></g>
    <g class="spin3"><circle cx="820" cy="160" r="5" fill="#E8ECFF"/></g>

    <!-- text: edit these two lines -->
    <text class="title" x="70" y="170">your-project</text>
    <text class="tag" x="74" y="222">A short line about what it does</text>
    <rect class="cursor" x="440" y="202" width="11" height="26" rx="2"/>
  </g>
</svg>
